Evaluate importance-sampling or exact SSF emission densities

Source: R/hmm.R
ssf_log_emissions.Rd

For J controls and the case in each choice set, returns eta_case - log(sum(exp(eta) / w)) + log(J). The case is included in the denominator and its numerator is unweighted, matching the published code. This is an approximate density, not a probability over the finite choice set. The measure underlying w must agree with the kernel being fitted. With exact normalisation, controls and weights are absent and the returned emissions are properly normalised canonical-kernel densities.

Usage

ssf_log_emissions(
  data,
  formula,
  coefficients,
  normalization = c("importance", "exact")
)

Arguments

data

Case-control prepare_ssf_data() data, or observed prepare_ssf_steps() data for exact normalisation.

formula

One-sided SSF formula without an identifiable intercept.

coefficients

Numeric matrix, with design columns in rows and states in columns. Row names must exactly match the design column names.

normalization

importance uses the published approximation; exact uses observed ssf_steps and the analytic canonical-kernel normaliser.

Value

A matrix of log emission densities, one row per stratum.
